params.maxCompletionTokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response.
params.maxTokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response.
params.temperature: Controls randomness in output. Higher values produce more creative responses, lower values produce more focused responses.
params.topP: Nucleus sampling threshold. Alternative to temperature, considers tokens with top_p cumulative probability.
params.topK: Limits the number of highest-probability tokens considered at each step.
params.frequencyPenalty: Reduces repetition by penalizing tokens that have already appeared in the text.
params.presencePenalty: Discourages the model from repeating topics by penalizing tokens that have already appeared.
params.stream: Stream tokens as they are generated instead of waiting for the full response.
params.stop: Custom stop sequences that signal the model to stop generating. Supports {{char}}, {{user}}, and {{name}} template variables.

native.maxLength: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response (Native API).
native.maxContextLength: Maximum context length for the prompt including generated tokens.
native.repetitionPenalty: Penalizes tokens based on their frequency in the prompt. Higher values reduce repetition.
native.topK: Limits the number of highest-probability tokens considered at each step.
native.topA: Top-A sampling: Limits tokens based on probability thresholds.
native.tfs: Tail Free Sampling: Reduces the impact of less probable tokens.
native.typical: Typical Sampling: Focuses on tokens with typical probability.
native.minP: Minimum probability threshold for token consideration.
native.samplerOrder: Order of sampler application as comma-separated indices.
native.n: Number of generations to produce per request.
native.trustedWorkers: Only use trusted workers with a proven reliability record.
native.slowWorkers: Allow slower workers to pick up the request.
native.allowDowngrade: Allow the Horde to reduce context/token limits if needed.
